# Kwikpik

> Nigerian fintech + logistics company. This repo hosts the Kwikpik design system: a Tailwind + Radix component library (`packages/ui`) generated from the Kwikpik Web3 Figma file, for the B2B/Finance dashboard, Logistics portal, marketing website, and mobile app.

## For AI agents

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): full design-system guide — setup, token philosophy, component-vs-variant rules, when-to-use-what table. Read this first.
- [packages/ui/registry.json](./packages/ui/registry.json): machine-readable component list — exact import paths, props, variant values, and the real product pattern each one maps to.
- [docs/design-system/](./docs/design-system/): deeper per-token/per-component reference docs with full Figma provenance.

## Docs

- [docs/flows/business-logic.md](./docs/flows/business-logic.md): confirmed KYC tiers, automation rules, Asset Split logic.
- [B2B_PLATFORM_UX_CONTEXT.md](./B2B_PLATFORM_UX_CONTEXT.md): full UX audit of the B2B/Finance module.
- [LOGISTICS_PLATFORM_UX_CONTEXT.md](./LOGISTICS_PLATFORM_UX_CONTEXT.md): full UX audit of the Logistics partner portal.
- [UNIFIED_ACTION_HUB_SPEC.md](./UNIFIED_ACTION_HUB_SPEC.md): the locked spec for merging both products behind one mode switcher + Action Hub.
